caption: The drawing features a park scene with prominent palm trees in the foreground, their fronds shaded with green, brown, and touches of white. The park's ground is a dark green with scattered yellow and brown patches, intersected by pale pathways. Several figures, dressed in long outfits colored in shades of cream, brown, and muted red, stand and walk throughout the park. Behind the people and trees, there is a large building with arched windows and a flat roof; a sign atop the structure reads "Castle Garden" in red letters. An American flag, predominantly white with a red and brown area for the stars, flies on a pole above the building. In the background, there is a blue body of water and a distant low green landscape or treeline. The overall sky is depicted in muted blue, filling the top third of the composition. The scene is framed by additional trees with green and brown foliage on either side. The image has a flat, graphic quality, with simplified shapes and bold outlines. At the bottom left margin outside the main image, there is a small measurement scale, and at the bottom right, a light outlined rectangle with a tape mark.
title: Bandbox
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
